item.title: Quantum computing lands on the grid first: three projects, one shared loop
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. Across the grid, hydrogen and solar projects, the quantum processor does one thing. It hands the classical solver a batch of candidates, and the feasibility check decides whether they survive. 1. One question, every evening# The National Energy System Operator in Britain balances supply and demand across England, Scotland and Wales.
